newsitem.title: USA: NYC may reshuffle GO bond and water syndicates.
newsitem.headline: NYC may reshuffle GO bond and water syndicates.

text.p: New York City, which has begun selecting underwriters for its new financing agency, said Friday these selections might cause it to reshuffle its existing underwriting teams.

"During and after the selection process for the Finance Authority underwriting team, the City and the New York City Municipal Water Finance Authority, in accordance with the recommendation of the mayor and the comptroller, each reserves the right to change its respective financing team," said the new, New York City Transitional Finacing Authority, in a prepared release.
